accepted_scope_caveats.label: Statistical kernel and certified-implementation layer
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claims are conditional on the explicitly maintained known fixed-rank, known homoskedastic Gaussian, square strong-donor, exact-span, incoherent bounded-entry regime; unknown-rank, approximate-factor, weak-donor, dependent-noise, and realized-outcome claims are outside scope.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform coverage, transition-length optimality, and any certified implementation result are claimed only under the stated strong-donor Gaussian model class.
